title: Structure and Exact Certification of Nonnegative Tensor Decompositions
abstract: arXiv:2610.32787v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the structure and exact certification of nonnegative tensor decompositions supplied through rational factor matrices. Every failure of minimality or essential uniqueness contains an irreducible positive exchange between $p$ supplied terms and $q$ competing terms. A dimension count based on the Lovitz--Petrov splitting theorem bounds the effective order of such an exchange, the sum over the modes of the joint factor-span dimension minus one, by $p+q-2$, and this bound is attained at every supplied length $R\ge2$. After eliminating ambient-row variables by the Farkas lemma, the resulting semialgebraic systems have fewer than $2R^2$ real variables. For input bit length $L$, this gives a deterministic $G(R)L^{O(R^2)}$-time algorithm that computes the nonnegative rank and an exact minimum-length decomposition, decides minimality and essential uniqueness, and returns exact witnesses when either property fails. The exponent is indepe

translated_title: 非负张量分解的结构与精确认证
translated_abstract: 我们研究了通过有理因子矩阵给出的非负张量分解的结构与精确认证问题。最小性或本质唯一性的每一次失效都包含一个不可约的正交换，即发生在 p 个给定项与 q 个竞争项之间的交换。基于 Lovitz--Petrov 分裂定理的维数计数将这种交换的有效阶数（即各模式上联合因子张成维数之和减一）界定为 p+q-2，并且在每个给定长度 R≥2 时该界均可达到。在利用 Farkas 引理消去环境行变量之后，所得的半代数系统的实变量个数少于 2R² 个。对于输入比特长度 L，这给出了一个确定性的、运行时间为 G(R)L^{O(R²)} 的算法，该算法能够计算非负秩并给出精确的最小长度分解，判定最小性与本质唯一性，并且当任一性质失效时返回精确的见证。
tldr: 本文为非负张量分解建立了结构性理论并给出精确认证算法，能在 G(R)L^{O(R²)} 时间内计算非负秩、求出最小长度分解、判定最小性与本质唯一性，并在性质失效时返回精确见证。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a structural theory and exact certification for nonnegative tensor decompositions, providing a deterministic G(R)L^{O(R²)}-time algorithm that computes the nonnegative rank, finds an exact minimum-length decomposition, decides minimality and essential uniqueness, and returns exact witnesses when either property fails.
